title: Deeper/broader DIMENSION DSTYLE, picture-block, and consumer-route review
mode: primary documentation and current public-source review
scope: Reconcile 7J DSTYLE serialization with Autodesk's DXF contract
Inspect independent ezdxf dimension override, resource, and geometry-block paths
Refine dimension picture-block and constraint-candidate closure criteria
Bind FreeCAD consumer evidence to importer backend and effective settings
Separate LibreDWG field mapping from semantic and native evidence

sources.name: Autodesk DXF DIMENSION, DSTYLE, and DIMSTYLE references
sources.observed: The public reference assigns group 2 to the picture block name, distinguishes dimension line spacing, actual measurement, and text rotation in groups 41/42/53, and specifies ACAD DSTYLE as typed XDATA inside control-string boundaries. It does not define DWG anonymous-block insertion scale/rotation as those DXF fields or equate a named target to a complete block graph.

sources.name: ezdxf dimension documentation and current implementation
sources.observed: The documented writer renders the dimension into an anonymous content BLOCK and writes overrides into ACAD:DSTYLE. The implementation maps version-sensitive resource names/handles, registers an existing geometry block when present, and its audit removes an ordinary dimension lacking a valid geometry block. It recognizes a constraint candidate by layer *ADSK_CONSTRAINTS plus absent geometry/group 2 and comments on a dependency reactor. Its AutoCAD/BricsCAD missing-block statements are project documentation, not independent native runs or normative DXF grammar.

sources.name: FreeCAD current DXF importer, preferences, and DWG route documentation
sources.observed: The current importer identifies *D anonymous blocks as dimension-related system blocks, can skip hidden/anonymous block contents according to settings, and composes collected block definitions separately from parsing. Annotation import is separately configurable. FreeCAD DWG import is a selected external converter followed by a selected DXF importer. Source inspection and documentation do not establish exact dimension rendering or released-build acceptance.

sources.name: LibreDWG current dimension model and DXF mapping generator
sources.observed: The public data model keeps DWG dimension block association, insertion scale, and insertion rotation as distinct fields; the generator maps the dimension block to DXF group 2. This informs field separation but is not runtime, closure, rendering, or native evidence.

assessment.planImpact: Clarifies ordinary versus constraint-candidate versus unclassified DIMENSION handling; defines group-2 block closure beyond a BLOCK_RECORD/name; binds FreeCAD qualification to annotation/block settings and converter stages; schedules ezdxf semantic comparison only at the optional composed checkpoint; keeps legacy behavior and unrelated implementation slices unblocked.

method.limitations: The review uses mutable current upstream source/documentation endpoints and is route-discovery evidence only. ezdxf's constraint recognition is a project heuristic; FreeCAD's source path does not prove user-visible dimension semantics; LibreDWG field declarations do not prove complete decode/write interoperability. Bind exact revisions and execute the named optional gates before promoting any claim.
